identities.workspace: Exact workspaceId shared by the imported worker workspace and the app. A mismatch conflicts.
identities.batch: Content hash of contract, workspaceId, monotonic sequence, creation time, worker revision, source job ID, and ordered captured evidence.
identities.evaluation: Exact captured evaluation ID, evaluatedAt, session/date, Eye ID, recipe ID/version, condition results, and input hash.
identities.manifest: Versioned checksum over the manifest body and ordered batches.
identities.acknowledgement: Content checksum over contract, workspaceId, sequence, and batchId.

capture.selects: Only newly created evaluation IDs in the committed result.
preserves: Eye owner identity and expected previous evaluation
Exact evaluation ID/time/session and captured result
Captured snapshot, provider/source/provenance, adjustment, freshness and quality
capture.durability: SQLite WAL batch and sequence rows are committed atomically with the worker workspace revision and job completion.

transport.ownerSetup: In web Settings, choose a private local directory once using the browser File System Access API.
transport.storedPermission: Browser directory handle in device-local IndexedDB; permission is checked on open and can be re-requested by Check for worker updates.
appWrites: ack.json only after the app state commit

ownershipAndReplay.evidence: Append-only historical evaluation/evidence records keyed by captured identity.
ownershipAndReplay.latestEyeEvaluation: Updated only after current owner identity, stock, recipe, referenced metrics, and previous evaluation identity match the capture.
ownershipAndReplay.sameBatchReplay: No new evaluation, alert, history row, or owner-visible work; the matching saved cursor is acknowledged again.
ownershipAndReplay.ownerHistory: Existing decisions, amendments, outcomes, notes, review logs, alert review/snooze/usefulness, and other unrelated app records are preserved.
ownershipAndReplay.overlap: Explicit conflict; no timestamp-based merge or silent overwrite.
ownershipAndReplay.outOfOrder: Sequence gap, workspace mismatch, identity collision, or changed referenced state is an explicit conflict or safe no-op.

recovery.appCommit: IndexedDB compare-and-set; a previous validated workspace copy is retained. The first save writes a valid empty baseline in the same transaction.
recovery.receiptOrder: Persist app state first, then atomically write the worker receipt.
recovery.interruptedReceipt: Worker retains the batch; app replays it without duplicates.
recovery.malformedOrIncompatibleManifest: Rejected before app mutation; prior valid app state remains available for restore.

workerSemantics: Atomic workspace and job result commit
